property_summary: For every admissible input that does not revert, C.transfer(...) returns true; the mutant returns false for those same inputs, so there exists an input where the return value differs (the reference always returns true on successful calls, the mutant sometimes returns false).

For every admissible input where C.transfer(...) completes (does not revert), the reference implementation returns true; the mutant returns false for some such inputs, so the observable return value differs (reference: true on success).

For any admissible inputs where transfer(...) does not revert, the reference contract C always returns true; the mutant returns false for at least one admissible input, so asserting that the return is true distinguishes them.

For every admissible input where transfer does not revert, the reference contract always returns true; the mutant inverts that final boolean and thus returns false for some inputs (so the return value differs).

For any admissible inputs that make C.transfer complete (not revert), C.transfer(...) always returns true; the mutant returns false for some such inputs (it returns !true), so the return value differs.
